assembly_summary: The original four-stroke shovel stays on the ground while a separately credited boot, leg and reaching hand enter. Ground marks are held; the operation follows source observations.
bounded_repair_v2: V1 independent critic: triangular grip wrongly visible. Extend existing shaft beyond left edge and translate the entire original grip offscreen along shaft axis. Existing angular blade, entering feet and final hand stay unchanged; original four-stroke topology retained.
